context: Integration test: a chart with images spanning all four license tiers. Tests that the agent correctly classifies each tier and emits a report sorted so the actionable findings (commercial + stale) appear at the top.

checklist.name: All four images present in graph
checklist.description: image-graph.json contains entries for nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged, registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/openjdk-21, docker.io/bitnami/postgresql:16, and docker.io/bitnamilegacy/redis:7.2.0. Nothing silently dropped.

checklist.name: Bitnami versioned classified as commercial
checklist.description: docker.io/bitnami/postgresql:16 is tier=commercial (post-retirement, the versioned tags are paid Bitnami Secure Images).

checklist.name: Report sort order puts commercial + stale at top
checklist.description: image-graph.md's per-image table is sorted so the commercial (Bitnami versioned) and stale (Bitnami legacy) entries appear BEFORE free-with-caveats (UBI) and free (nginx). The actionable findings sit at the top.

checklist.name: Escapes recommended for non-free entries
checklist.description: The three non-free entries (UBI, Bitnami versioned, Bitnami legacy) carry escape recommendations. The free entry (nginx) carries no-escape-needed.

checklist.name: No fabricated CVE references
checklist.description: Report does NOT cite specific CVE identifiers.
